abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Hallowed Strikes
abilities.description: Casting an ability grants you ranged (850u) basic attacks and 30.0/30.0/30.0/30.0/30.0/36.0/36.0/36.0/36.0/36.0/42.0/42.0/42.0/42.0/42.0/48.0/48.0/48.0% attack speed for the next two basic attacks. These attacks deal (+8% physical power) bonus physical damage and bounce 2 times, dealing 15.0/15.0/15.0/15.0/15.0/20.0/20.0/20.0/20.0/20.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/25.0/30.0/30.0/30.0% damage to targets hit.

abilities.name: Anima Burst
abilities.description: Perform a spinning kick that deals 70.0/90.0/110.0/130.0/150.0 (+70% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s. If cast in-air, you will additionaly leap upwards in your current movement direction. Heal 20.0/35.0/50.0/65.0/80.0 (+75% physical power) health, increased by 0-50% based on missing health if an Enemy Hero or Monster is hit.

abilities.name: Severance
abilities.description: Rush forwards, dealing 55.0/75.0/95.0/115.0/135.0 (+115% physical power) physical damage to targets hit. Colliding with a target affected by Soul Rip consumes it to reset the cooldown of Severance and tear their Soul from the target for 4s. Souls linger around their hosts with 8% of their maximum health and share any damage dealt to them with their host. Consuming Soul Rip with a Soul still active will refresh its health.

abilities.name: Whispering Echoes
abilities.description: Launch three projectiles that explode, each dealing 30.0/40.0/50.0/60.0/70.0 (+35% physical power) damage to targets hit and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.

abilities.name: Soulstorm
abilities.description: Channel for 1.5s, dealing 75.0/125.0/175.0 (+50% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and applying Soul Rip to them. At the end of the duration, pull all targets towards you, tear their spirits and strike downwards, dealing 130.0/215.0/300.0 (+80% physical power) physical damage and reset the cooldown of Severence.

augments.name: Hallowed Reverberation
augments.description: Hallowed Strikes gains 150 additional range and bounces 2 more times.

augments.name: Soul Weaver
augments.description: Soul Storm grants 20% (+5% per Hero Hit) Damage Reduction while active, and its Cooldown is 10% lower.

augments.name: Ephemeral Surge
augments.description: Destroying Torn Spirits restores 3% of your Maximum Mana and grants 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 2.5s.
